title: Torus-embedded exact spectral kernel ridge regression on real climate grids: a CPU-only future-blind benchmark with calibrated reconstruction intervals and ENSO-transfer evaluation
problem: On regular lat/lon climate fields, exact kernel ridge regression with a stationary kernel requires an N x N solve, so scalable treatments default to approximate routes (RFF, Nystrom) or structured but non-exact grid GPs. The closest circulant-KRR sibling in the corpus (Yin et al. 2019) is an approximate sketch on non-grid data, and none of the spectral/structured kernel papers (KISS-GP, Fastfood, GPyTorch) reports peak RSS or flop/byte cost on real climate anomaly fields. Climate-ML evaluation is benchmark-first with random-split leakage (corpus gaps G1-G3, Gap Coverage section, entries 26-40). Missing: a systematic, honest, CPU-only evaluation of torus-embedded exact circulant-block KRR on real SST anomaly fields under a leakage-verified, future-blind protocol with resource accounting as a first-class axis.
method: Exact BCCB spectral KRR on the Kaplan SST v2 5-deg anomaly grid (36x72): alpha = irfft2(rfft2(y) / (max(rfft2(c_torus), 0) + lambda)), O(N log N) time / O(N) memory, CPU-only. EXACTNESS QUALIFICATION (pinned): the exactness claim holds for the periodic-torus-embedded kernel only; the free-boundary stationary Gram is BTTB and the torus-vs-free kernel difference is measured per kernel per grid in the pilot (real test field: relative gap 0.95 matern32 / 0.12 rbf) and disclosed in the abstract/limitations; the boundary-corrected (FFT-preconditioned CG) solve is the masked-input arm and its residual/convergence are reported. Sentinel-aware data handling (NCAR missing -9.96921e36 -> missing mask; impute with valid-cell monthly mean; missing cells excluded from every evaluation target; 53.4% of cells missing, 100% polar caps). Four operating modes: (i) spectral masked-cell reconstruction; (ii) kernel-consistent Nino3.4 box functional; (iii) frequency-domain transfer forecast (per-mode ridge transfer function, DC pinned to 1, applied forward in time); (iv) FFT-preconditioned CG for masked-input exact free-boundary solves. Calibrated uncertainty via per-kernel calendar-month-block conformal intervals (conformity score = absolute residual per held-out VALID cell; threshold = 0.90 quantile of the 60 terminal in-train same-calendar-month scores; denominator excludes missing cells explicitly). Significance via pre-registered win rules with a WORKING year-block bootstrap (true calendar years 2016-2022, 7 blocks, 2000 draws with replacement, se and CI from the draw distribution; n_blocks/n_resamples reported in the artifact).

experiment_design.data: Kaplan SST v2 monthly anomalies 1856-01..2023-01 (2005 months, 36x72); train 1856-01..2015-12 (1920 months); test 2016-01..2022-12 (84 months); 2023-01 excluded from both; temporal-block CV inside train; 2015/16 El Nino peak (Dec 2015) inside train so only the decay phase is test-side.
arms: P0 pilot exactness gate on a real test-window field (spectral == dense floored-torus to 1e-6 rel; torus-vs-free gap reported per kernel and DISCLOSED in the headline)
T1a masked-cell reconstruction on the 84 test months (random 10/30/50% + halo w1/w2/w4) with per-kernel calendar-month conformal coverage diagnostics
T1b masked-input exact free-boundary PCG (10/30/50%, tol 1e-8, max 3000 iters; rel-residual > 10x tol -> relaxed-tol marker, never silent)
T2 Nino3.4 functional index regression, 5-fold temporal-block CV vs zero-model and direct ridge head

T3 transfer forecast h in {1,3,6,12} vs persistence/climatology/AR(1); year-block bootstrap (7 calendar-year blocks, 2000 draws, seed 7, se + CI reported); seam (Dec-Jan boundary skill split); START-MONTH x LEAD skill tables (origin months {0,3,5,9} x h) as the spring-barrier evidence; truncation sweep + 2015-excluded-vs-retained
B sklearn baselines (exact subsample n in {2k,5k,10k} capped by valid-cell pool 4.8k; Nystrom 5000; RFF 5000) on the same real anomaly cells
S O(N log N)/O(N) scaling (synthetic grids through N=10,368; 0.25-deg single-field resource estimate ~0.04 GB with the batch-memory note)
R resolution sensitivity + flop/byte ratio control (critique a + d)

critique_items_pinned.a_grid_resolution_sensitivity: identical protocol on the native 5-deg grid vs a 2x2 block-mean coarsened 10-deg grid of the SAME anomaly fields (protocol stability check); explicit h=12 ENSO floor analysis with the same (fixed) bootstrap machinery; start-month x lead skill tables
critique_items_pinned.b_real_data_threats: Kaplan reconstruction-smoothing caveat stated (optimally interpolated reconstruction; index std 0.794); land/polar missing masks (53.4%, 100% polar) -> valid-only evaluation with the denominator formula explicit; PCG non-convergence fallback pre-stated
critique_items_pinned.c_coverage_tolerances: PER-MASK acceptance: global |coverage-0.90| <= 0.06; seam subset (2016-2017) <= 0.06; decay subset (2016) <= 0.12; every violation is disclosed in the artifact and limitations - no averaging across masks
critique_items_pinned.d_cholesky_ratio_control: exact subsample arm on the same real anomaly cells, RBF kernel, one accuracy metric (pooled-cell RMSE on 2000 valid test cells), one flop and one byte estimate per method, flop/byte and accuracy-per-flop/byte ratios vs the spectral baseline
critique_items_pinned.e_trailing_discard: explicit 1-3 trailing-year discard: truncation sweep cutoffs 2014-12 / 2013-12 / 2012-12 plus 2015-excluded-vs-retained split, test window FIXED 2016-2022
critique_items_pinned.f_calibrated_interval_acceptance: per-mask acceptance with full violation list; mean-deviation rule rejected

experiment_design.win_rule: supported at horizon h iff spectral transfer beats persistence AND train-only climatology AND train-only AR(1) in RMSE AND skill score AND margin vs best baseline (MSE) exceeds the year-block bootstrap 95% CI half-width; refuted if > half of horizons fail; indeterminate otherwise. Bootstrap: true calendar-year blocks (2016-2022), 2000 draws with replacement, se/CI from draws, n_blocks and n_resamples reported. No post-hoc reinterpretation.
experiment_design.resources: CPU-only (NumPy/SciPy/scikit-learn; h5py for data reading), 12 cores / 7 GB / <= 90 min; measured full-benchmark 108 s wall, 1.55 GB peak RSS; budget note: the Nystrom-5000 fit dominates the B arm (~46 s) - amortized single execution, no repeated Nystrom refits in re-runs.
experiment_design.honest_framing: no FFT-kernel newness, no spectral-regression newness, no SOTA-ENSO-skill claims; exactness = torus-embedded kernel only, free-gap disclosed; contribution = concrete circulant-block CPU implementation + real-data reconstruction/index benchmark + leakage-verified evaluation protocol + resource accounting; every artifact carries dataset.origin=real-kaplan-sst-v2 and no simulation marker.

expected_significance: Masked-cell reconstruction RMSE 0.0816-0.0880 (matern32, ~14% of test-window field anomaly std) with per-mask calibrated coverage diagnostics (target 0.90; violations disclosed, e.g. wide-halo decay subsets); functional index RMSE 0.0856 (corr 0.997) vs direct ridge head 0.270 (3.2x) and zero-model 0.795 under strict temporal-block CV at O(N log N) cost; honest negatives under pre-registered win rules (h=6 beats persistence but not AR(1); h=12 floor; spring-barrier degradation evidenced by start-month x lead tables); resource accounting 108 s / 1.55 GB; O(N) memory scaling.
originality: (1) first CPU-only torus-exact BCCB-KRR real-data benchmark with resource accounting in the indexed corpus (Yin 2019 is approximate and non-grid; Fastfood/GPyTorch report no such axis); (2) integrated leakage-verified evaluation protocol as a reusable practice (non-exchangeable conformal + bootstrap-DM win rules + seam/decay/truncation checks + start-month x lead tables), closing corpus gap G3; (3) honest negative-result reporting under pre-registered semantics, including per-mask coverage violations.
